legalName: Delaware mandatory and automatic expungement under 11 Del. C. Secs. 4373 and 4373A
routeSelectionNote: The exact route is fixed as obligation:track-pathway:DE:de_mandatory_expungement:mandatory-and-automatic-expungement-under-11-del-c-4373-and-4373a. The guide selects that agency route and presents no alternate instrument for the participant to elect.

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Every case number, court, county, charge, and statute section
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Every case number, court, county, charge, and statute section
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no participant case or criminal-history record is held
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the identifiers and every charge in each case exactly as the official records state them; confirm it with the court records and the participant's current Delaware criminal-history record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Current incarceration, parole, or probation status
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Current incarceration, parole, or probation status
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform cannot know the participant's current custody or supervision status
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether any incarceration, parole, or probation is still being served and its completion date; confirm it with the supervising or correctional agency and the sentencing court

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform cannot see or certify the participant's financial-obligation status
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether all financial obligations associated with the conviction are paid and, if not, the exact balance and reason; confirm it with the court clerk or agency maintaining the official balance

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Prior, later, and pending criminal matters
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Prior, later, and pending criminal matters
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform does not hold a complete criminal history and cannot decide the statutory tier
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: a complete account of other convictions and pending charges, including the offense and disposition of each; confirm it with the participant's complete criminal-history and court records and SBI

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Disposition, conviction, release, and sentence-completion dates
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Disposition, conviction, release, and sentence-completion dates
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform cannot determine the case outcome or calculate a participant-specific waiting period
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the exact outcome and all dates SBI needs to evaluate the applicable branch and waiting period; confirm it with certified court and correctional records

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform cannot see the participant's current record or SBI processing status
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the exact record that still appears and whether SBI says the monthly automatic process has reached it; confirm it with the participant's current record and the Delaware SBI Expungement Section at 302-739-5884

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: SBI eligibility letter and current instructions
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: SBI eligibility letter and current instructions
requiredBeforeFiling.why: SBI supplies these participant-specific instructions only after determining eligibility
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the eligibility determination, next steps, destination, required materials, and any fee stated by SBI after its review; confirm it with the eligibility letter and instructions supplied directly by Delaware SBI
